name: NostalgiaTV Server
description: A self-hosted live TV guide and HDHR tuner for Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby libraries, with a browser-based Watch and Configure UI.
short_desc: Create a live TV guide from your Plex, Jellyfin, or Emby libraries.
author: purestream711

form_fields.label: Timezone
form_fields.hint: Use an IANA timezone, such as America/New_York.

form_fields.label: User ID (PUID)
form_fields.hint: Use id -u on the host to find your user ID.

form_fields.label: Group ID (PGID)
form_fields.hint: Use id -g on the host to find your group ID.
